sentences.en: So, so for folks out there who are interested in, you know, joining route for me, what are sort of the opportunities available?
sentences.zh: 那么，对于那些有兴趣加入 route for me 的朋友们，有哪些可用的机会呢？

sentences.en: Do you have internships?
sentences.zh: 你们有实习岗位吗？

sentences.en: Do you have full-time positions?
sentences.zh: 你们有全职职位吗？

sentences.en: And, and so what, what kind of folks are you looking for?
sentences.zh: 还有，你们在寻找什么样的员工？

sentences.en: We do have internships.
sentences.zh: 我们确实有实习岗位。

sentences.en: We are actively hiring.
sentences.zh: 我们正在积极招聘。

sentences.en: And, you know, I would say that that's in terms of what we're looking for in terms of folks, it's someone who, you know, believes in what we're doing.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，我想说，就我们在寻找的人才而言，是那种相信我们所做事情的人。

sentences.en: And I think that's just really critical in, you know, from our perspective, we really are on a mission to save the world.
sentences.zh: 我认为这真的很关键，从我们的角度来看，我们确实肩负着拯救世界的使命。

sentences.en: So if you want to join that mission, as much as it may sound, you know, a lot of people may kind of say, you know, oh, that's childish or, oh, that's, you know, way too big.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你想加入这个使命，尽管这听起来，你知道，很多人可能会说，哦，这太幼稚了，或者，哦，这，你知道，太宏大了。

sentences.en: I think everyone has an opportunity to make an impact.
sentences.zh: 我认为每个人都有机会产生影响。

sentences.en: And so from perspective of developers, always looking for developers.
sentences.zh: 所以从开发人员的角度来看，我们一直在寻找开发人员。

sentences.en: And then we're also hiring in many other roles as well from even just support.
sentences.zh: 然后我们也在许多其他岗位上进行招聘，甚至包括客服支持。

sentences.en: I think, you know, that's a wonderful opportunity to get your foot in a door and start to understand what are these problems that, you know, businesses and people are facing
sentences.zh: 我认为，你知道，这是一个很好的机会，可以让你迈进门槛，开始了解企业和人们

sentences.en: on a daily basis and how can we help them?
sentences.zh: 每天都在面临哪些问题，以及我们如何才能帮助他们？

sentences.en: Cool.
sentences.zh: 太好了。

sentences.en: That makes sense.
sentences.zh: 这说得通。

sentences.en: I think a couple of things that we, we touched on was the API.
sentences.zh: 我想我们提到的一两件事是 API。

sentences.en: And so I believe you mentioned route for me.io.
sentences.zh: 所以我想你提到了 route for me.io。

sentences.en: That's a place for developers to check out API, but you also have route for me.com, right?
sentences.zh: 那是开发人员查看 API 的地方，但你们也有 route for me.com，对吧？

sentences.en: Unless it's somebody else.
sentences.zh: 除非那是别人的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Route for me.com is our main website.
sentences.zh: Route for me.com 是我们的主要网站。

sentences.en: So if you want to go start a web trial, you can start a free web trial, which includes access to the web and to the mobile apps.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你想开始网页端试用，你可以开始一个免费的网页试用，其中包括访问网页端和移动端应用。

sentences.en: You can also just download our mobile app straight from the app store, either the iOS Apple store or the Google play store and
sentences.zh: 你也可以直接从应用商店下载我们的移动应用，无论是 iOS 苹果商店还是谷歌应用商店，然后

sentences.en: start a mobile trial as well, or just download the free mobile app and use that.
sentences.zh: 开始移动端试用，或者直接下载免费的移动应用并使用它。

sentences.en: I think it enables a certain amount of free routes per month and just play around with it.
sentences.zh: 我认为它允许每月免费使用一定数量的路线规划，你可以随便玩玩。

sentences.en: If you'd like to mess around and, but route for me.com is kind of our main site for the actual productize service of the technology.
sentences.zh: 如果你想折腾一下的话，但是 route for me.com 算是我们提供该技术产品化服务的的主网站。

sentences.en: Cool.
sentences.zh: 酷。

sentences.en: Cool.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: That makes sense.
sentences.zh: 很有道理。

sentences.en: So yeah, everyone check that out.
sentences.zh: 所以，大家去看看吧。

sentences.en: It's got a free trial.
sentences.zh: 它提供免费试用。

sentences.en: You could, you try a different routes.
sentences.zh: 你可以尝试不同的路线。

sentences.en: You could play with the API.
sentences.zh: 你可以使用API进行开发。

sentences.en: I think it'd be really fun.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这会非常有趣。

sentences.en: I think it's a good experience to, you know, try out this tech.
sentences.zh: 我觉得体验一下这项技术是个很好的经历。

sentences.en: And I think you'll learn a lot along the way.
sentences.zh: 而且我想你在这个过程中会学到很多东西。

sentences.en: And one opportunity is there's so many really wonderful organizations out there that do a lot of work that to underserved communities and underserved populations.
sentences.zh: 其中一个机会是，有那么多非常棒的组织，他们为服务不足的社区和群体做了大量工作。

sentences.en: I'm really proud that, you know, we partner with those communities to help them, you know, get access to our software.
sentences.zh: 我真的很自豪，我们能与这些社区合作，帮助他们使用我们的软件。

sentences.en: And so from delivering meals to the needy to, you know, there's a lot of different programs and organizations.
sentences.zh: 因此，从为有需要的人送餐，到各种不同的项目和组织。

sentences.en: So you could always find a little niche if you want to get some experience and just kind of say, Hey, I've got this organization and we want to help them.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你想积累经验，随时可以找到一个小领域，然后说，嘿，我们有这个组织，我们想帮助他们。

sentences.en: And it's a really great cause get in contact with us.
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常伟大的事业，请与我们联系。

sentences.en: We'd be more than happy to help.
sentences.zh: 我们非常乐意提供帮助。

sentences.en: It's really our mission to make the world a better place and save the world.
sentences.zh: 让世界变得更美好、拯救世界确实是我们的使命。

sentences.en: And so whether it's through the APIs or even just the web platform, I mean, we've helped delivered a lot
sentences.zh: 因此，无论是通过API还是仅仅通过网络平台，我的意思是，我们已经帮助发送了许多

sentences.en: of, you know, Thanksgiving turkeys to people who otherwise wouldn't have them.
sentences.zh: 感恩节火鸡给那些本来吃不上的人。

sentences.en: And so we're really, really proud of that.
sentences.zh: 对此我们感到非常非常自豪。

sentences.en: So get your hands dirty, get involved, find a way to help people and we'll find a way to help you as well.
sentences.zh: 所以，卷起袖子干吧，参与进来，找到帮助别人的方法，我们也会找到帮助你的方法。

sentences.en: Cool.
sentences.zh: 酷。

sentences.en: I can't keep up with it.
sentences.zh: 我应付不过来。

sentences.en: Cool.

sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.zh: 这太棒了。

sentences.zh: 你知道，我们真的很深入地探讨了这东西是如何运作的。

sentences.en: I think people, I mean, I'm sure people will get an appreciation for, you know, just like how incredibly complicated, you know, this technology is.
sentences.zh: 我想人们，我的意思是，我确信人们会体会到，这项技术是多么的不可思议地复杂。

sentences.en: And it's amazing that you've made it so accessible to so many people, but we've
sentences.zh: 你让这么多人能够轻松使用它，这真的很了不起，但我们也

sentences.zh: 向人们展示了冰山一角，这样他们就能深入研究这项技术，

sentences.en: and, and, you know, really learn a lot of those really niche skills that I think are going to become,
sentences.zh: 并且真正学到很多那些非常冷门的技能，随着软件吞噬世界，然后人工智能吞噬软件，

sentences.zh: 我认为这些技能随着时间的推移会变得更加重要。

sentences.en: And so, or machine learning maybe eats software.
sentences.zh: 或者说可能是机器学习吞噬软件。

sentences.en: And so this is right at the heart of some really cutting edge tech that I think is super, super exciting.
sentences.zh: 所以这正是某些真正尖端技术的核心，我觉得这超级超级令人兴奋。

sentences.en: So thank you so much Parker for coming on the show.

sentences.zh: 也谢谢大家在Patreon和其他平台上支持本节目，并在我们制作节目时关注我们的节目周边。

sentences.en: So, you know, thanks for your support.

sentences.zh: 因此，我们能够提升制作量，接触到更多全新的听众。

sentences.en: And so if you're new to the show, you know, welcome, you know, you can always email us, you just go to programmingthrowdown.com.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你是节目的新听众，欢迎你，你可以随时给我们发邮件，只需访问programmingthrowdown.com。

sentences.en: And just don't hesitate to reach out and say, hi, we also have a discord with a active chat going.
